AKB1-149 - Ren'ai Sousenkyo.name: AKB1/149: Renai Sousenkyo
AKB1-149 - Ren'ai Sousenkyo.summary: AKB1/149: Renai Sousenkyo is the third entry of the AKB1/48 dating sim series, now featuring all promoted members from AKB48, SKE48, NMB48, and HKT48.

Armored Core - Formula Front Extreme Bat.name: Armored Core: Formula Front - Extreme Battle
Armored Core - Formula Front Extreme Bat.summary: Unlike most other, action-oriented Armored Core titles, this installment is a strategy game. The player has no direct control of the mech in the action but can customize the mech as always, implementing additionally an AI that will fight on its own. The role of the player is to customize the mech and train the AI on training arenas. The "Extreme Battle" international release of the game included additional combat scenarios.

Kanon.name: Kanon
Kanon.summary: A port of Kanon on the PlayStation Portable, featuring the CGs in widescreen, adding voice-acting to the main protagonist and a 'Capture' option to save any scene in the game to Memory Stick.

Monster Hunter Portable 2nd.name: Monster Hunter Freedom 2
Monster Hunter Portable 2nd.summary: Monster Hunter Freedom 2 is a standalone PSP entry that adapts the core content of Monster Hunter 2 into a new single-player campaign, with additional content created for the handheld release. Players complete hunting, gathering, and treasure quests, using materials obtained from monsters and the environment to craft and upgrade weapons and armor. Quests can be undertaken alone or cooperatively by up to four players through local ad hoc multiplayer.

Phantasy Star Portable 2 Infinity.name: Phantasy Star Portable 2 Infinity
Phantasy Star Portable 2 Infinity.summary: Phantasy Star Portable 2 Infinity (or PSP2∞) is an enhanced version of PSP2 released on 2/24/2011 in Japan. The game features a new muiltiplayer lobby, new storyline, a new race called Dumans, and the new weapons will take the total count to over 3,000.
